intro.notes: Welcome. This deck is **served by slidecast**: open it as a viewer on the projector and as a presenter on your laptop or phone.

how.notes: Three steps on this slide; each press reveals one line.

steps.1: Point at your clicker: `PageDown` works too.
steps.2: Open a second tab as a viewer to see the sync.

roles.notes: Presenter and admin need a password unless you run slidecast on your own machine.

keys.notes: `B` blanks every viewer screen. Press it again to come back.

end.notes: Edit these notes in the admin panel: `/admin`, then **Edit notes**.
